BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 1,000,000 ordinary shares at an average price of 75.78 pence per share, with the highest price paid being 76.8p and the lowest 73.9p. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of ordinary shares in issue to 340,769,725, with 3,867,640 shares held in treasury. The number of shares available for shareholders to use as a denominator for notification purposes under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules is now 336,902,085. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 10 August 2026 10 August 2026 Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. Date of purchase: 03 August 2026 04 August 2026 05 August 2026 06 August 2026 07 August 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 186,416 263,290 206,815 231,443 178,384 Highest price paid per share (pence per share): 76.4p 76.5p 76.5p 76.2p 76.8p Lowest price paid per share (pence per share): 75.3p 73.9p 76p 75.2p 75.6p Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share): 75.9674 75.3238p 76.2951p 75.5809 76.4154 The Company notifies the market that at the date of this announcement the Company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 340,769,725 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1p each ("Ordinary Shares") with each share carrying one vote. In aggregate, 3,867,640 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 336,902,085 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. This disclosure is made pursuant to paragraph 9.6.6(R) of the Listing Rules. The table below contains detailed information about the purchases made as part of the Share repurchase programme.
